title: Phone storage explorer and animation backups
summary: Plan a shared phone storage explorer for byte-preserving downloads and single-storage/base-relative bulk ZIP backups with a provenance manifest, durable real folders/playlist folders, and guarded actual path moves within and between Internal and External storage. Include compatible Internal hierarchy, identity/settings migration, bounded transactions and reconciliation, targeted inventory updates and Clocks-only boundaries. ZIP import stays in seed73 without a restoration promise. The owner approved the shared protocol additions in advance on 2026-11-06. Part A (tasks 1-4) is built and delivered in open PR #53, and part B (tasks 5-8) is built and delivered in open PR #64; neither is merged, and the board session and the owner's phone and LED checks are open.
